PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR PREFERENCE IS GRANTED PER CCP 36(A). TRIAL IS OCTOBER 9, 2012 AT 11:15AM IN DEPARTMENT 503. LAST DAY FOR HEARING SUMMARY MOTIONS IS SEPTEMBER 27, WITH OPPOSITIONS DUE 5 COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING AND REPLIES DUE 2 COURT DAYS BEFORE THE HEARING. PLAINTIFF STIPULATES THAT HITCO CARBON COMPANIES' SUMMARY MOTION MAY BE HEARD ON 50 DAYS NOTICE WITH AN ADDITIONAL TWO DAYS FOR E-SERVICE. PLAINTIFF TO MAKE A SETTLEMENT DEMAND ON ALL DEFENDANTS NO LATER THAN SEPT. 10, 2012. SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE IN ROOM 603 AT 1:30 PM SEPT. 27, 2012. FACT DISCOVERY CUT-OFF DATE IS SEPT. 21, 2012. EXPERT DISCOVERY CUT OFF DATE IS OCT. 5, 2012. NO LATER THAN JULY 13, 2012, PLAINTIFF MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING, AS TO EACH DEFENDANT, THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIMS. NO LATER THAN JULY 13, 2012, DEFENDANTS MUST PROVIDE A STATEMENT STATING THE NAME AND CONTACT INFORMATION OF EACH PERSON WITH KNOWLEDGE OF ANY FACTS SUPPORTING ANY OF DEFENDANT'S AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSES. ANY PERSON NOT IDENTIFIED ON THE STATEMENTS WILL BE BARRED FROM TESTIFYING AT TRIAL OR PRESENTING A DECLARATION ON A SUMMARY MOTION ABSENT GOOD CAUSE SHOWN. THE PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER REGARDING ANY OTHER SCHEDULING OR OTHER ISSUE WHICH ANY OF THEM WANT TO HAVE INCLUDED IN THE PREFERENCE ORDER. FURTHER CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE ON SEPT. 18, 2012 AT 1:30PM. NO NEED FOR ANY PARTY TO FILE ANY CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE STATEMENT. PARTIES MAY APPEAR AT THE CONFERENCE BY TELEPHONE. THERE WILL BE A MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE ON OCT. 5, 2012 AT 1:30 P.M. WITH THE COURT PURSUANT TO S. F. LOCAL RULES OF COURT 5. PARTIES TO SUBMIT STATEMENTS BY OCT. 3 AND APPEAR BY PERSONS WITH FULL AUTHORITIES TO SETTLE. CLIENT MUST BE PRESENT AT THE CONFERENCE OR SEEK APPROVAL BY THE COURT TO BE ON TELEPHONE STANDBY. COUNSEL FOR PLAINTIFF TO PREPARE AN ORDER. JUDGE: TERI L. JACKSON, REPORTER: PATRICIA RODRIGUEZ, CSR #12436 (503)
